open_points.subject: request-time run-spool removal
open_points.text: “a store call that fails changes no record ... and the request is answered as an internal error by module:surface” contradicts “a removal that fails or is interrupted fails nothing: what is left is removed at the next start”
open_points.question: When remove_run_spool fails after a run has ended or been released, does the request succeed with cleanup deferred, or return internal_error and stop the kernel?
options: The run-ending or release request succeeds; the committed record stands and remaining files are retried at startup
The request returns internal_error and the kernel stops after responding
open_points.default_guess: Treat spool removal as the explicit exception: succeed and defer cleanup.

open_points.subject: startup recovery after an unknown outcome was resolved not_applied
open_points.text: “an attempt the owner resolved concludes from its records and is not reached again” contradicts “not_applied: the element waits again with reason owner_approval” and the requirement to reach it again to request a fresh approval
open_points.question: If the kernel crashes after recording a not_applied resolution but before creating the fresh approval request, must startup recovery reach the element and request that approval?
options: Reach it again and create the fresh approval request
Do not reach it again because every resolved attempt is treated as concluded
open_points.default_guess: Reach a not_applied element again; only applied resolutions produce a final succeeded or failed conclusion.
